BETA Close X CRH plc announced on February 26, 2026, that it repurchased 61,192 of its ordinary shares on February 25, 2026, for an aggregate consideration of approximately $7.4 million, with a volume-weighted average price of $121.37 per share. These repurchases are part of CRH's share buyback program, aiming to repurchase up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026. Following these transactions and subsequent cancellation, CRH will have 670,044,836 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and will hold 35,661,896 ordinary shares in treasury, representing 5.053% of the issued share capital. Disclaimer* 26 th February 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 25 th February 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 670,044,836 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,661,896 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.053% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
